subject: storytime
title: Wild Things words
about: A boy in a wolf suit gets into trouble and is sent to his room, where a forest grows and a boat carries him to an island of huge roaring creatures who make him their king. This level teaches the words the child will meet in the book, so the library copy is easier to read on his own.
tip: After the level, borrow the book from the library and read it together, with him doing the roars.

book.author: Maurice Sendak
book.source: a library favorite; this level teaches its words, the app does not contain the book
book.blurb: The classic Caldecott Medal picture book about a boy, his temper and a wild island far away.

cards.note: capital M, it is his name; x says ks
the o says oo as in book: woolf
oo says long oo, like moon
pp is one p; two parts: sup + per; supper is dinner
two parts: for + est; or says or
c-r blend; ow says ou as in out, like in cow
oar says or, like in oar: ror
ee says long e; th is one part, at the end
c-l blend; aw says aw, like saw; the s says z
igh says long i, like in light
the i says its name, like in child: wyld
magic e makes o say its name
th is one part; ng is one sound; the s says z
